scope: GEIPAN English normalization and CE1-CE5 encounter classification
classification_policy: Highest applicable public encounter class wins. CE1-CE5 describes reported encounter content and does not assert that the report is true or unexplained. GEIPAN A/B/C/D remains separate source metadata.
narrative_language_policy: English first, followed by the preserved French original.
metadata_language_policy: English where translation/localization is appropriate; proper names remain proper names; source French retained in provenance.
semantic_review: Automated classification followed by targeted semantic review of physical-effect, occupant/entity, and transport/abduction edge cases.
